current_bottleneck: The 293 family now needs a stronger but still explicit support representation. Hidden latents are near cap, and monolithic coarse support is directionally right but too entangled to predict well. The likely next bottleneck is the all-at-once coarse path classification problem itself.
last_result_summary: Iteration 138 completed the 293e ideation cycle. The selected next mechanism is a compositional explicit support object: predict a sequence of coarse knot tokens rather than one monolithic coarse path code, then interpolate those knot panels into the same explicit scaffold used by the daily joint-token decoder.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 293e-v0 with knot-token sequence support prediction and the same local daily joint-token decoder.
